messages.text: There,s a new review comment - address it and prepare the PR for merging.
I’ll check the new review comment, address it, and verify the affected PR is ready to merge.

The comment is on [#145](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/145); #142–144 and #146 have been merged. It selects ALLIGRO LAr with the 400 mm gap as the nODD baseline and requests one SVG comparing ODD, Si-W, staggered Si-W, and LAr. I’ll update the report and baseline records, keeping the plotted response-width definition explicit.
I’m using the repository’s review workflow and PDF skill for this update, including a rendered-page check of the revised report.

The retained data support matched broad-spectrum curves for Si-W, staggered Si-W, and LAr. ODD has fixed-energy measurements at three directions, so I’ll show those as clearly labelled reference points on the same SVG and identify the cohort difference.

The three matched samples can be rebinned to 0.05-wide |η| bins without new simulation, and the independent physics check supports that approach. I’ve recorded the LAr baseline selection and marked the existing 800 mm combined export as an integration control pending the service and collar fit.

The four-series SVG is generated and embedded in the revised eight-page report. All 10,000 matched primaries are retained, and the LAr results reproduce the ten existing fine-bin values and intervals. I also corrected the figure’s y-axis label placement and a PDF page overflow found during rendering.

The independent physics review reproduced all 180 fine-bin statistics and every bootstrap interval, and confirmed the ODD reference points. It found no scientific issues. The publication review is checking the report wording and source records before I publish the update.

The publication review found two corrections: the comparison must use the repository’s fixed ECAL colour, with line and marker styles distinguishing configurations, and the ODD source-access date must remain 15 November. I’m fixing both; the calculated data are unchanged.

Both publication findings are now closed. The final SVG and report passed the targeted recheck; all statistical data and the other seven PDF page streams are unchanged. I’m publishing the response, retargeting #145 to `main`, and running the final merge checks.
The GitHub connector can read the PR but cannot edit its metadata. I’m using the authenticated CLI to publish the prepared description and change the target to `main`.

Local validation passes, including the figure replay, negative input check, project records, and token logging. I’m pushing the reviewed update to #145, then checking CI at that exact commit. I won’t merge it.
#145 is updated, targets `main`, and is mergeable. Its token/accounting workflow is green; GitHub is still queuing the broader project-validation run.

The final project-validation run has started. The published branch includes the corrected SVG, eight-page PDF, baseline-selection record, and review/token logs; I’m waiting for its hosted checks to complete.
The calorimeter checks have passed on hosted CI. The PR also retains its `campaign:calorimeters` and `scope:baseline-design` labels. The remaining project checks are progressing without failures.
The analysis/replay job is fully green. The broader build is finishing tracker checks before the final repository-record checks.
The build is at the tracker integration checks, with no failures so far. The calorimeter analysis, accounting, and independent report reviews have passed.
The tracker integration step is still running. I’m keeping the turn open until the full current-head CI result is available.
CI shows no new failures. The remaining build is still at the combined tracker integration checks; the accounting and analysis jobs are green.
The long tracker integration step passed. CI has moved on to the last component controls before the final record checks.
The detector controls have passed. CI is running the final project-record and documentation checks; no further source changes have been needed.
The final record-check step is still running. The branch remains mergeable, and there are no new review findings or CI failures so far.

Addressed [#145](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/145). It now targets `main`, is mergeable, and **all CI checks pass**. Review findings and token/work logs are updated. No merge performed.

Recorded the LAr400 working-baseline selection and added the [comparison SVG]([redacted] ODD uses labelled fixed-energy reference points; the three matched curves use fine η bins. The combined 800 mm export remains an integration control pending service/collar qualification.

The revised report remains eight pages.
